records.title: feat(hybrid-agent): implement dual-layer scoped github mcp and tower verification
records.author: paykaribazaronline
records.reflection_why: Establish a unified, safe Hybrid Architecture for external web agents (Devin, OpenHands, web runners) allowing fast read queries via scoped GitHub MCP while routing all write/patch executions strictly through SupremeAI Control Tower.
records.alternatives_rejected: Pure Direct GitHub MCP (high blast radius, bypasses invariants), Pure MCP Tower (lacks broad read versatility for issues and discussions).
